skill.name: influencer-discovery
skill.description: Use when the user asks to "find influencers", "build an influencer list", or "discover creators in [niche]"; produces a multi-platform candidate pool, per-influencer profiles with audience and engagement metrics, authenticity red-flag screening, and a tiered shortlist with fit scores. Not for scoring or ranking a known shortlist — use fit-scorer.
skill.summary: Discover creators across platforms, screen for fit, and build a campaign-ready influencer shortlist.
skill.author: aaron-he-zhu

security_audit.summary: Most static findings are false positives caused by Markdown code fences, inline backticks, relative documentation links, and public URLs. The skill does include an optional YouTube connector command that can execute local code and consume a YouTube API key, so that path needs explicit opt-in. I found no prompt injection text or malicious data-exfiltration intent in the reviewed files.

remediation.issue: Optional YouTube connector command can execute local code and use an API key.
remediation.suggestion: Require explicit user confirmation before running the connector, validate the handle argument, and state what data is sent to YouTube.

remediation.issue: Connector instructions depend on files outside this skill package.
remediation.suggestion: Package required connector documentation with the skill or replace parent-directory paths with marketplace-safe references.

content.value_statement: Finding credible creators takes time, and inconsistent notes create weak shortlists. This skill structures multi-platform discovery, screening, profiles, and handoffs for campaign teams.
actual_capabilities: Defines campaign search criteria across niche, platform, follower range, location, language, and exclusions.
Builds candidate pools using hashtags, similar accounts, competitor mentions, platform discovery, and user-provided sources.
Screens creators for engagement, recency, relevance, brand safety, fake follower signals, and competitor conflicts.
Creates creator profiles with metrics, audience notes, content analysis, partnership history, contact path, and preliminary fit score.
Compiles tiered shortlists with campaign mix guidance and handoffs to scoring or outreach workflows.
limitations: It does not compute final weighted fit scores; it hands candidates to fit-scorer for ranking.
It relies on public data or user-provided inputs unless optional connectors are available.
It cannot guarantee current follower counts, engagement rates, or contact paths without source verification.
It must not scrape private, login-gated, or prohibited platform data.

use_cases.title: Build a micro-creator roster
use_cases.description: Find niche creators that match a campaign brief, then screen them for audience fit and brand safety.

use_cases.title: Expand into a new platform
use_cases.description: Compare creator options across TikTok, YouTube, Instagram, LinkedIn, X, or Reddit before investing budget.

use_cases.title: Refresh an agency pipeline
use_cases.description: Create repeatable candidate notes, shortlist tiers, and next-step handoffs for multiple client campaigns.

prompt_templates.title: Find a starter creator list
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner search for a simple shortlist.
prompt_templates.prompt: Find 20 influencers in [niche] for [brand]. Focus on [platforms], [location], and [follower range]. Return a screened shortlist with reasons.

prompt_templates.title: Screen for audience fit
prompt_templates.prompt: Build an influencer list for [campaign]. Use [audience], [brand-safety rules], and [exclusions]. Separate must-reach, strong, and consider tiers.

prompt_templates.title: Profile selected creators
prompt_templates.prompt: Create discovery profiles for these handles: [handles]. Include audience quality, engagement signals, recent content, partnership history, contact path, and concerns.

prompt_templates.title: Design a discovery pipeline
prompt_templates.prompt: Create an always-on discovery plan for [brand]. Cover search methods, platform priorities, weekly review rhythm, scoring handoff, and CRM-ready candidate notes.

output_examples.input: Find 15 micro-influencers in sustainable fashion for a new eco clothing brand.
output_examples.output: A report lists reviewed candidates, qualified creators, top recommendations, tier notes, audience fit signals, concerns, and next-step handoff.

output_examples.input: Profile these five YouTube creators for a skincare product launch.
output_examples.output: Each profile includes visible metrics, audience quality notes, content themes, partnership signals, contact path, and fit concerns.

output_examples.input: Create a creator discovery plan for a B2B software brand entering LinkedIn.
output_examples.output: The plan defines search criteria, account sources, screening rules, shortlist tiers, cadence, and scoring handoff.

best_practices: Start with clear audience, platform, follower range, location, and exclusion rules.
Verify recent content and engagement quality before trusting follower counts.
Use public business contact paths and record confidence when data is incomplete.
anti_patterns: Do not rank creators only by follower count.
Do not guess private email addresses or scrape login-gated pages.
Do not skip brand-safety checks when a creator has strong engagement.

faq.question: Does this skill contact influencers?
faq.answer: No. It prepares candidate lists and contact paths, but outreach should happen in a separate approved workflow.

faq.question: Can it use live platform data?
faq.answer: It can use public pages and user-provided data. Optional connectors may improve accuracy when available and approved.

faq.question: Does it rank final winners?
faq.answer: No. It creates preliminary fit signals and sends final ranking to the fit-scorer workflow.

faq.question: Which platforms can it cover?
faq.answer: It can cover Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, X, LinkedIn, Reddit, and other platforms with available sources.

faq.question: How should teams handle privacy?
faq.answer: Use public business information only. Do not scrape login-gated pages or guess private email addresses.

faq.question: Can Claude, Codex, or Claude Code use it?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill declares support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code compatible hosts.
